claims.text: The rider in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground with cinematic Hollywood drama, dramatic expressions, and camera movement.

Asset-1 shows the same adult man across its panels: medium-tan complexion, lean build, shaved sides, small back topknot, a diagonal scar above his right eyebrow on the viewer-left side of his face, black high-collar field or tactical jacket with shoulder straps and buckles, black crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

Asset-2 shows a single black dragon design with very dark charcoal-to-black scales, subtle blue-green iridescence, long pale bone-colored horns sweeping backward, a spiked crest, large membranous bat-like wings, four stout clawed limbs, a long spiked tail, and an orange eye.
The battleground is staged as a smoke-and-ember volcanic plain with distant opposing ranks and drifting ash.
A dark orchestral battle score with low brass, tense strings, and a rising drum pulse accompanies the action.

soundscape: A cold wind moans over the volcanic plain, carrying distant battle rumbles, deep wingbeats, and the gritty hiss of blowing ash.
music: A dark orchestral score with low brass, tense strings, and a rising battle-drum pulse.
